_doc: Phase 0 of the EU extract engine: the platform taxonomy. LIVE config (read by services/extract/classifier.py): each platform's `anti_bot` + the per-body `overrides` (platform, anti_bot) drive URL->platform routing. REFERENCE catalogue (NOT read at runtime; handlers.parse() implements the equivalent selectors in code, kept in sync by tests/extract_engine/test_extract_engine.py::test_config_selectors_no_drift): `selectors`, `date_strategy`, `pagination`. Source: reference_eu_web_estate_scraper_standard + every economy_*.py docstring.

wordpress.label: WordPress / Elementor
wordpress.note: filename-title PDFs; Elementor post grids may need a browser

dynamics.label: Microsoft Dynamics / Power Pages
dynamics.note: Dataverse + AJAX; cards not in server HTML

jcms.label: Jalios JCMS
jcms.note: probe 26 Jun: news/events JS-rendered, needs browser

sharepoint.label: Microsoft SharePoint
sharepoint.note: probe 26 Jun: eca/events served static via requests; browser is fallback not default

spa.label: SPA + search backend
spa.note: near-empty server HTML; hit the underlying JSON/Algolia API where one exists, else render

bespoke.label: Bespoke / custom-article
bespoke.note: per-site selector map maintained by hand

anti_bot_profiles.rate_limit_cooldown: paced requests; on /challenge, pause IP-wide cooldown (minutes) then resume; never burst
anti_bot_profiles.pow_solve: solve the proof-of-work (Anubis) in a real browser context
anti_bot_profiles.cookie_handshake: establish a session cookie via browser, then fetch
anti_bot_profiles.js_faceted: cards render only after a client-side filter; run the filter in a browser or call the search API

eur-lex.note: JS-WAF on SEARCH; /content/news index is static (probe 26 Jun)

echa.note: probe 26 Jun: 0 items in server HTML, JS-rendered

_probe_26jun: 12/21 golden URLs OK via requests, 9 need browser; all 4/4 passes stable. See tests/extract_engine/probe_golden.py output.
